messages:
tanya: Quick sync — the new runtime/dashboard for model-serving is merged and visible in staging. We need to nail the alerting rules + PagerDuty routing before prod rollout. Main metrics: runtime.request_latency_p95, runtime.error_rate, runtime.slo_burn_rate. Can eng-sre + oncall help propose thresholds?

mike: SG. Do we want burn-rate-based paging only, or also absolute thresholds for p95/p99?

raj: Prefer burn-rate for SLO violations, absolute for capacity spikes. Example: burn_rate (1h) > 4 => page, burn_rate (1h) between 2-4 => warn in Slack. For latency: p95 > 400ms for 5m => warn, p95 > 800ms for 5m => page.

sarah: Agree on burn rates. Also call out error_rate: >1% for 5m => page. Most of our product teams want lower noise so can we make a 5m consecutive window for paging to reduce flapping?

elaine-bot: FYI — the new dashboard widget includes links to runbooks: https://wiki.redwood.internal/runbooks/runtime-slo and the rollout notes.

raj: Here is a draft Prometheus-style rule we can use (staging test):
```
- alert: RuntimeSLOBurnRateHigh
  expr: slo_burn_rate{service="runtime"}[1h] > 4
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "Runtime SLO burn rate > 4 (1h)"
```

mike: That looks good. For Labels/PD routing: severity=page -> pagerduty service "runtime-oncall"; severity=warn -> slack channel #platform-alerts. Is the PD service already created?

raj: Not yet. I can create PD service + escalation policy. Proposal: primary (runtime-oncall) -> backup (eng-sre) -> escalation to incident response. Weekday hours have 2-person routing, nights 1-person.

oncall-sre: Quick note — we should limit paging to incidents that impact production customer-facing API. For internal-only degradations route to platform oncall but mark low urgency. Also prefer to have an automatic fallback to lower-cost models rather than paging for small degradations.

mike: Good point. We can add a label impact:customer=true/false and route accordingly. impact:customer=true + severity=page -> page PD. impact:customer=false -> Slack alert only.

sarah: For runbook, add steps to check: 1) recent deploys 2) model variant routing 3) autoscaler errors 4) GPU/utilization. I can add the checklist.

tanya: Can we also include a temporary test mode? We should be able to trigger a synthetic alert in staging that follows PD routing so teams confirm escalation policy and message contents.

raj: Yep — plan: create alert in staging, then use `curl -XPOST` to /alertmanager/api/v1/alerts with a fake metric; have PD integration point to a staging PD service. I'll schedule a 15m test next Tue.

mike: Small ask for console UX: show the alert rule with a collapsed human-readable summary and a toggle to enable PD routing. Product wants to be able to flip small volume alerts to Slack-only without going to infra config.

tanya: That's part of the rollout UX we discussed — add an "escalation policy" dropdown on the rule card. Work with product to copy PD mapping metadata when exporting rules to prod.

sarah: Also call out SLO burn-rate math: we use 1h window for detection, but validate that it matches frontend SLO windows. We should avoid mismatched windows across dashboards.

elaine-bot: Deploy bot: staged alerting rule applied to staging cluster at 1767892000.

oncall-sre: One more operational note — add a 15m auto-silence when we flip canaries/rollouts so we don't immediate-page during controlled traffic shifts.

raj: Agreed. I'll add `annotations: runbook`, `impact` labels, and a `for: 5m` buffer and submit PR to alerting. Putting a draft PD service + escalation policy in PD.

mike: I'll mock the console card for the toggle and send screenshots to this thread. :thumbsup:

tanya: Thanks — next steps: raj creates PD service + PR for alert rules, mike creates console mock, sarah updates runbook checklist, we test on Tue. If anyone wants to be on the test call ping raj/offcall.

sarah: Pinged. I'm available for the test.

raj: Creating PD service now and will update the PR link here when ready.

mike: Screenshot posted in #design-review.

elaine-bot: Reminder: link to staging dashboard: https://staging.metrics.redwood/runtime-slo

tanya: Great work team — keep the thread updated with PR links and PD service ID.

deploy-bot: rollout:alerting-staging v0.3 deployed by raj at 1767893500.
